title: No task covers session revocation
desc: The plan requires refresh tokens to be revocable, and SessionStore.revoke already exists, but no generated task exercises or wires it. Add a task that revokes the stored session on logout and asserts the token can no longer be redeemed.

title: T002 acceptance criteria omit the eviction bound
desc: T002 says entries older than WINDOW_SECONDS are dropped but never states the resulting bound on the store, so the criterion is not verifiable. State the post-condition explicitly: after eviction the store holds only entries inside the window.

title: T003 does not name the lockout threshold under test
desc: T003 asks for regression tests but does not say which MAX_ATTEMPTS boundary the test pins, so two implementers would write different tests. Name the boundary in the description.
